title: Make explicit placement after stale automatic mailbox admission recoverable or actionable
outcome: An explicit Active placement request for a native root retaining a stale automatic mailbox binding either safely re-admits the mailbox route first or returns an actionable refusal that names the valid recovery operation.
acceptance: A stale automatic binding after re-enrollment or lost mailbox placement authority cannot produce only an opaque PREPARE refusal; recovery preserves identity/receipt and explicit execution-grant boundaries.
Focused stale-auto-to-explicit-placement coverage and review demonstrate the chosen recovery or actionable error without granting execution from mailbox-only authority.
